metadata.page_title: Pat Pidgeon vs Millan’s Last Supper matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 50.0. Pat Pidgeon left 17.5 lineup points on the table, while Millan’s Last Supper left 2.9.
summary.historical_summary: Pat Pidgeon is 7-4 against Millan’s Last Supper across 11 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 50.0, led by a 37.2-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Jahmyr Gibbs (48.2) and Dak Prescott (44.1).
summary.loser_reason: Millan’s Last Supper could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 37.2 points. Ravens scored 2.0. A best legal lineup added 2.9, still short of the 50.0-point margin.
